Sample.evidence_source: [009_therapists_and_treatment_integrity] To ensure treatment integrity, (a) detailed treatment manuals were used for both CBT and IPT; (c) therapists received training in one of the treatment model to which they were assigned; and (d) weekly supervision meetings were held separately for each CBT and IPT team in which sessions were reviewed and planned using the manual's indications. ... a compliance rate of 85% for IPT therapists and a compliance rate of 91% for CBT therapists.
